agent_explanation: Controller uses velocity-error law F = kp*(v_desired - v_perceived). With sensor noise 0.228, perceived velocity is perturbed, increasing velocity error. The implementation applies noise after the fmax clamp (or adds noise to force/desired velocity with gain), so final commanded force 83.438 exceeds declared fmax 64.183. Counterfactual with noise=0 clamps exactly at fmax and passes, proving noise handling breaks force limiting.
